name: カラーバンディング検出
description: 検出します posterization and quantization アーティファクト in smooth 勾配s. AI images may show subtle color banding due to limited color depth in generated content.
algorithm: Gradient Step Detection + Banding Ratio Analysis
mechanism: 分析します smooth 勾配 regions for discrete color steps を比較することで adjacent pixel differences. Banding indicates quantization from AI generation or heavy compression.
parameters: Step 検出 閾値: 2, Gradient range: 3-40, Window: 5 pixels
useCase: Detecting color quantization アーティファクト in AI生成の images

references.title: Wang, Z. et al. (2004). Image Quality Assessment: From Error Visibility to Structural Similarity. IEEE TIP.
Daly, S. (1992). Visible Differences Predictor. SPIE Human Vision.
Lee, S. & Bovik, A.C. (2002). Fast Algorithms for Signal and Image Processing. IEEE TSP.

strengths:
• Effective at detecting posterization and quantization アーティファクト
• Reveals bit-depth reduction from processing
• Complementary to 勾配 and ヒストグラム methods
• Works にわたる all image formats
• Low computational cost
limitations:
• Natural smooth 勾配s may trigger 誤検出
• Display calibration affects visual verification
• Less effective on high-bit-depth images (16-bit)
• Heavy dithering can mask banding アーティファクト
• Subtle banding may be below 検出 閾値
